info.title: WAYLO API
info.description: Flights from airline-authorised partners and shared airport rides. Money is integer paise (INR minor units); timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. In demo mode every integration (airline, payments, maps, flight status, messaging) is a labelled sandbox: no real tickets, payments or rides.

400.description: Invalid input. `details` lists the failing fields.
